title: SRE Weekly Update - 2026-09-12
content:
Summary:
- Week of 2026-09-06 -> 2026-09-12. Focus: incident follow-ups, SLO review, on-call handoff improvements, and prep for the DB schema maintenance window on 2026-09-20.
- No customer-facing outages this week; two internal incidents required mitigation and follow-ups.

Incidents:
1) SRE-874: intermittent 5xx spike on hosted-api (2026-09-08 10:40 - 2026-09-08 12:05) - RESOLVED
   - Symptoms: Short-lived p50/p95 latency bump and 5xx errors for ~85 minutes for a subset of routes (text-generation v1).
   - Root cause: Memory pressure on a small pool of Dedicated inference hosts triggered by a rare degenerate prompt pattern that prevented KV cache eviction.
   - Mitigation: Temporarily enabled per-route request caps and drained affected hosts. Applied a hotfix to the runtime to force KV eviction when memory crosses threshold (rollout v0.9.21).
   - Postmortem: Draft posted to Confluence (see linked artifacts). Action items: add synthetic test for degenerate prompt pattern, add mem-pressure alert on host pool (P1), update runbook steps for forced KV eviction.

2) SRE-879: replication lag spike in telemetry pipeline (2026-09-10 02:15 - 2026-09-10 03:00) - RESOLVED
   - Symptoms: Delayed delivery of metrics to observability backend (Grafana/Prometheus pipeline), impacting dashboards and alerting for ~45 minutes overnight.
   - Root cause: Backpressure due to a burst of long-running eval jobs that exceeded the pipeline's burst capacity + a misconfigured retention setting on an intermediate queue.
   - Mitigation: Increased pipeline consumer parallelism and temporarily relaxed retention to clear backlog. Scheduled follow-up to tune consumer concurrency and add a circuit-breaker for large eval jobs.
   - Postmortem: Owner assigned (Priya Nair). Follow-ups: limit eval job concurrency by default, surface job size to job submitter UI.

SLOs / Metrics Snapshot (end of week):
- Hosted API availability SLO (99.95% monthly): current month-to-date 99.97% (0.02% error budget remaining).
- Request success rate (all routes) MTD: 99.92%
- p50 latency (text-generation): 120ms; p95: 450ms; p99: 820ms
- Telemetry pipeline lag: median 8s, p95 42s (post-incident baseline improved to p95 18s after mitigation)
- Notes: Error budget burn due to SRE-874 is modest but flags need for preventive tests.

On-call handoffs / Rota notes:
- Outgoing: Evan T. handed off to Diego A. on 2026-09-09 09:00 PDT. Items highlighted: KV cache hotfix rollout, monitoring of dedicated pools, and the scheduled DB migration prep checklist.
- Incoming: Diego A. to hand off to Morgan L. on 2026-09-16. Please review the incident follow-ups before handoff.
- Runbook updates: Added a step to the "host-memory-pressure" runbook for forced KV eviction and a new dashboard to surface per-host memory headroom.

Action Items (owners):
- Add synthetic test for degenerate prompt pattern that reproduces KV growth (Evan Thompson) - due 2026-09-19.
- Add host-pool memory-pressure alert and tune thresholds (Diego Alvarez) - due 2026-09-15.
- Complete postmortem for SRE-874 and link to customer-facing summary (Morgan Liu) - due 2026-09-14.
- Limit eval job concurrency and add circuit-breaker to telemetry pipeline (Priya Nair) - due 2026-09-27.
- Verify rollback plan and runbook for DB schema maintenance (Morgan Liu & infra team) - due 2026-09-18.

Meeting notes (Weekly SRE sync 2026-09-12):
- Attendees: Morgan Liu, Evan Thompson, Priya Nair, Diego Alvarez, Jamie Park (infra), Noah Chen (observability).
- Agenda: incident reviews, SLO status, DB migration readiness, on-call improvements.
- Decisions:
  1) Move forward with hotfix (already deployed) but schedule a canary across 10% of traffic for 72 hours to validate eviction change. (Owner: Morgan Liu)
  2) Require eval job submissions above threshold to be reviewed by infra and default to low parallelism. (Owner: Priya Nair)
  3) Implement per-host memory headroom dashboard and add it to on-call home dashboard. (Owner: Diego Alvarez)
- Risks discussed: the DB schema migration on 2026-09-20 remains the highest risk item; agreed to freeze non-critical infra changes 48 hours before the window.

Planned changes / Maintenance windows:
- DB schema maintenance (read-replica swap + small index rewrite): 2026-09-20 02:00 - 04:00 UTC. Change advisory published; SRE will staff a 2-person on-call for the window.
- Rolling restart of dedicated pool (to pick up runtime v0.9.21): scheduled staggered restarts starting 2026-09-18 to reduce blast-radius.

Runbooks / Documentation updates:
- Updated: host-memory-pressure runbook (added forced KV eviction step).
- New: per-host memory headroom dashboard doc (link in Confluence).

Risks & Mitigations:
- Risk: Degenerate prompts causing memory pressure could recur on other model families. Mitigation: add prompt classification + synthetic tests, extended canary coverage.
- Risk: Telemetry lag leading to delayed alerts. Mitigation: circuit-breaker and reduced eval concurrency; add a high-priority alert if backlog > X minutes.

Notes / Misc:
- Observability: Request to retention team for 30-day hot metrics retention for SRE dashboards (submitted as request RQ-2026-0911).
- Hiring: SRE hiring update — two offers extended; one candidate starting 2026-10-01.

Appendix - Quick runbook links:
- Host memory pressure runbook: Confluence /display/SRE/Runbooks#HostMemory
- KV eviction script: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/ops/scripts/kv-evict.sh
- Incident drafts: Confluence SRE-874 draft, SRE-879 draft

End of update.
